answer: Rate-limit new identities with a proof-of-work ticket whose difficulty is keyed to the registrant's network neighborhood: each /24 subnet starts at 2^20 hashes and the target doubles for every identity admitted from it within 90 days. A fable of a thousand fake accounts would force one operator to forge 2^30 hashes for the tenth, and a reef of shared hosts pays the same toll. Validators recompute the single hash against the posted target, so verification costs microseconds.
